clue.text: Obtain pass

definitions.meaning: to obtain something is to get hold of it
to pass is to go by or drop in on someone

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are idioms: to acquire something, and to call in or travel past a place.

clue.text: Produce a lower type of offspring

definitions.text: Produce a lower type of offspring

parts.words: Produce a lower type of offspring
parts.note: a lower is something that lows, a cow, so this means a cow giving birth

explanation.definitionFit: A cow giving birth to its young is said to do this.

clue.text: He produces a pass when charged

definitions.text: He produces a pass when charged

parts.words: He produces a pass when charged
parts.note: a bullfighter sweeps his cape past the bull as it charges

explanation.definitionFit: A bullfighter makes passes with his cape as the bull rushes at him.

clue.text: A piece of one's mind?

parts.note: giving someone a piece of one's mind is scolding them; read literally, a tiny unit of the brain

explanation.definitionFit: A neuron is literally one small component of the brain.

clue.text: Scoundrel who deserves no good fortune

definitions.meaning: read literally, someone whose allotted portion should be poor

explanation.surface: A rogue who has earned nothing but misfortune.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes 'lot' in its old sense of one's fate or share, so a poor lot is a poor fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for a villain, and literally means a poor share of luck.

clue.text: She gives a direction to the printer to erase

parts.words: direction to the printer to erase
parts.note: dele is the proofreader's mark telling a typesetter to delete

explanation.surface: A woman marks up a proof telling the typesetter to delete something.
explanation.walkthrough: DELE is Latin for 'delete', used as a proofreading instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, so it stands for a woman referred to as she.

clue.text: Falling behind in providing winter insulation?

definitions.meaning: material wrapped round pipes and tanks to stop them freezing

explanation.definitionFit: The word means trailing behind and also the material used to wrap pipes against cold.

clue.text: Marry poet, but it turns out to be short-lived

indicators.note: the phrase signals that the letters of marry poet turn into a new order

explanation.definitionFit: Something lasting only a while is fleeting or transient.

clue.text: Leading frigate almost wrecked, debris seen

indicators.note: the leading letter of the word frigate is the one taken
something wrecked is broken up, so the letters of almost are rearranged

explanation.surface: A ship's lead vessel nearly destroyed, with wreckage visible on the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' looks like an instruction to shorten the previous word, but it is the anagram fodder for 'wrecked'; 'seen' is a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Floating wreckage from a ship is the classic example of debris at sea.

clue.text: As played by the advanced tennis player?

definitions.text: As played by the advanced tennis player?

parts.words: As played by the advanced tennis player?
parts.note: a tennis player who has advanced up the court volleys close to the barrier dividing the court

explanation.definitionFit: A style of play based at the front of the court, volleying near the mesh, suits a player who comes forward.

clue.text: One drink to put some life into another

parts.note: to ginger something up is to liven it
another drink here is ale, a type of beer

explanation.surface: A tonic that peps up a second beverage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' points back to 'drink', so it stands for a second drink, here ale.
explanation.definitionFit: A carbonated soft drink flavoured with the root spice is a single drink, often a mixer.

clue.text: Late? Punctual? Or very punctual?

parts.note: late in the sense of deceased
punctual means arriving at the right moment

explanation.surface: A string of questions about whether someone is late or on time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Late' looks like the opposite of punctual, but it means deceased; 'dead' also works as an intensifier meaning exactly.
explanation.definitionFit: Being exactly at the scheduled moment is an intensified way of saying prompt.

clue.text: I have an old-fashioned image

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape or make, so the word old is remade in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone owns a picture in a dated style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old-fashioned' reads as one adjective meaning dated, but the hyphen hides a split: 'old' is the fodder and 'fashioned' the anagram signal; 'have an' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An effigy or graven image worshipped as a god is the original sense.

clue.text: Charming hostess who helped her guests make pigs of themselves

definitions.text: Charming hostess who helped her guests make pigs of themselves

parts.words: Charming hostess who helped her guests make pigs of themselves
parts.note: the enchantress of Greek myth who turned Odysseus's crew into swine; charming means casting spells

explanation.definitionFit: In the Odyssey the sorceress entertains the sailors and transforms them into hogs.

clue.text: Potentially fierce sea battle avoided by this

indicators.note: the letters of fierce sea are what the solution could become if rearranged

explanation.surface: A truce that could prevent a violent naval engagement.
explanation.definitionFit: A truce halts fighting, so a battle is averted by it.

clue.text: Aptitude and ambition may put the team on top

definitions.text: may put the team on top

parts.note: a gift is a natural talent
a goal is an aim or ambition

explanation.surface: Talent and drive can lift a side to the top of the league.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the result: an easy score handed over by opponents can put a team ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: An easy score conceded by an opponent's blunder can give a side the lead.

clue.text: No intention of going to court

definitions.text: No intention of going to court

parts.words: No intention of going to court
parts.note: court in the sense of wooing: someone with no wish to romance anyone is unattached

explanation.definitionFit: Being unattached and carefree means having no plan to seek a partner.

clue.text: Single-minded man?

parts.note: read as a man minded to stay single, that is unmarried

explanation.definitionFit: An unmarried man is one who keeps to the single life.

clue.text: Just a few difficult to control

definitions.meaning: a small number, as much as fits in the palm
an unruly child or animal is described this way

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a small quantity and also a person or animal that is hard to manage.

clue.text: No way in-that's bad

indicators.note: the word for way goes inside the word for no

parts.note: nay is an old word for no
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Refusing entry is an unpleasant thing to do.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphen in 'in-that's' is a printing quirk; 'in' is the container signal and 'that's' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unpleasant or wicked is a close synonym of foul or vile.

clue.text: Transport that gets up speed by putting one's foot down

definitions.text: Transport that gets up speed by putting one's foot down

parts.words: Transport that gets up speed by putting one's foot down
parts.note: putting one's foot down usually means pressing the accelerator, but here it means pushing off the ground

explanation.definitionFit: A child's kick vehicle is propelled by pushing a foot against the pavement.

clue.text: If French, is a non-runner

parts.note: a French variety of this vegetable is distinct from the runner variety

explanation.definitionFit: French and runner are both kinds of this climbing legume, so a French one is not a runner.

clue.text: Jovial acknowledgement of a bad standard

parts.note: jolly means cheerful
roger is the radio word for message received

explanation.surface: A cheery reply to a poor level of work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standard' means a flag, not a level of quality: the pirates' skull-and-crossbones banner.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a flag, and the pirate skull and crossbones flew for villains.

clue.text: Such jolts may be physical

parts.note: physical exercises done briskly at school drill are known by this name, as well as sudden jerky movements

explanation.definitionFit: Sudden sharp movements, and the term for drill exercises, both fit the word.

clue.text: The English opening used in tournament

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for English
a vent is an opening or outlet

explanation.surface: A classic chess opening played at a competition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The English opening' sounds like the chess opening, but it is E plus a word for an opening.
explanation.definitionFit: A competition at a sports meeting is called by this word, as in a track contest.

clue.text: Fails to correspond?

parts.note: to correspond can mean to match or to exchange letters; this reads it as matching

explanation.definitionFit: Not matching something means being unlike or at variance with it.

clue.text: Squander food?

definitions.meaning: to waste time or money bit by bit
a battered fried piece of food, such as a banana or apple one

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to waste gradually and also a piece of fried battered food.

clue.text: Engage in silent wrestling

indicators.note: wrestling twists and contorts, so the letters of silent are rearranged

explanation.surface: Take part in a wrestling bout without a sound.
explanation.definitionFit: To engage someone can mean to recruit or sign them up, as in joining the army.

clue.text: Acquired permit ran out inside

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are placed inside the word for permit

parts.note: to let is to allow or permit

indicators.note: out signals the letters of ran in a different order

explanation.surface: A licence that had expired was obtained.
explanation.walkthrough: 'permit' looks like a noun, a licence, but it works as the verb; 'out' signals the anagram and 'inside' the container.
explanation.definitionFit: To have picked up knowledge or a skill is to have acquired it.
